title: Synthetic MFA Recovery Policy
content: Synthetic demo policy only. Employees with ERR_MFA_403 must contact the help desk for identity verification. The help desk verifies identity before restoring MFA access. Never share an MFA recovery code in a ticket or chat.

title: Synthetic Backup Operations
content: Synthetic demo policy only. When ERR_BACKUP_502 occurs, operations staff inspect storage capacity and the last successful backup. A human administrator reviews any proposed incident status change before it is executed.
